zh.title: 長榮航空星空聯盟塗裝787-10返回松山　B-17812執飛羽田航線
zh.summary: 長榮航空星空聯盟塗裝787-10 B-17812於10月7日由桃園調度至松山，隨後執飛BR190前往東京羽田，讓這架特殊塗裝客機再次現身松山機場。
body: 長榮航空註冊編號B-17812的波音787-10，於2026年10月7日由臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）調度至臺北松山機場（TSA），隨後執飛前往東京羽田機場（HND）的BR190航班，讓這架星空聯盟塗裝客機再次出現在松山機場。
根據Flightradar24航班追蹤紀錄，該機當天下午2點50分以BR3810航班自桃園起飛，約於下午3點04分降落松山，飛行時間約13分鐘；完成調度後，於下午4點45分起飛執行BR190航班。上述時間均為臺北時間。
B-17812於2023年5月交付長榮航空，至今約三年五個月，是長榮首架採用星空聯盟塗裝的787-10。該機引進時適逢長榮加入星空聯盟十週年，因此採用聯盟塗裝，與一般長榮客機的綠色機尾外觀有所不同。
目前僅可確認的是該機此次返回松山並執飛羽田航線，尚無航空公司或機場的公開資訊說明後續派遣期間。計畫前往拍攝的民眾宜留意當日實際執飛機號與航班動態，避免將此次調度視為固定安排。

en.title: EVA Air Star Alliance-Liveried 787-10 Returns to Songshan, B-17812 Operates Haneda Service
en.summary: EVA Air's Star Alliance-liveried Boeing 787-10 B-17812 repositioned from Taoyuan to Taipei Songshan on October 7 before operating BR190 to Tokyo Haneda.
body: EVA Air Boeing 787-10 B-17812 repositioned from Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) to Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA) on October 7, 2026, before operating flight BR190 to Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND), bringing the Star Alliance-liveried aircraft back to Songshan.

According to Flightradar24 flight records, the aircraft departed Taoyuan at 2:50 p.m. as BR3810 and landed at Songshan at about 3:04 p.m., for a flight time of roughly 13 minutes. After the repositioning sector, it departed again at 4:45 p.m. to operate BR190. All times are Taipei local time.

B-17812 was delivered to EVA Air in May 2023 and is now about three years and five months old. It was EVA Air's first 787-10 to wear the Star Alliance livery. The aircraft entered the fleet around the tenth anniversary of EVA Air joining Star Alliance, and its alliance scheme differs visibly from the green-tail appearance of the airline's standard livery.

For now, the confirmed information is limited to the aircraft's return to Songshan and its operation of the Haneda route. Neither the airline nor the airport has publicly indicated how long this assignment will continue. Aviation enthusiasts planning to photograph the aircraft should check the actual tail number and current flight status on the day rather than assume the deployment is permanent.
